userText: Last weekend I had a really relaxing time. On Saturday morning, I slept in and then made pancakes for my family. In the afternoon, I went to the park with my best friend, and we played badminton for almost two hours. Although I lost most of the games, I enjoyed it a lot because the weather was perfect. On Sunday, I stayed at home and finished reading a novel that I had started last month. In the evening, my parents and I cooked dumplings together, which is our little family tradition. It was a simple weekend, but I felt happy and recharged.
aiRevision: Last weekend was very relaxing. On Saturday morning, I slept late and made pancakes for my family. In the afternoon, I went to the park with my best friend and played badminton for about two hours. I lost most games, but I really enjoyed it because the weather was nice. On Sunday, I stayed at home and finished reading a novel I started last month. In the evening, my parents and I cooked dumplings together — it’s our family tradition. It was a simple weekend, but I felt happy and rested.
errorSentences: 'slept in' 是较地道的表达，但对 A2 学习者略偏高；建议用更基础的 'slept late'；
'Although' 引导的让步状语从句超出 A2 语法范围（A2 要求 mainly simple sentences 和 basic conjunctions like 'but', 'and', 'because'）；应简化为 'but'；
‘recharged’ 是较高级词汇（B1+），A2 更常用 'rested', 'felt fresh' 或 'felt good again'；
整体句式流畅自然，动词时态（一般过去时）使用准确，人称和搭配无误。
suggestions: 你已经能熟练使用一般过去时描述完整周末活动，句子连贯、逻辑清晰，非常棒！个别表达（如 'slept in', 'although', 'recharged'）稍高于A2水平——这说明你在主动拓展，值得鼓励！下次可多尝试用A2核心词（如 'late', 'but', 'rested'）来保持准确性和自信。继续保持真实、具体的日常描写，这是语言进步最扎实的方式。
